findings.quote: Time on the lathe rises with a bell's weight, so a bell of a tonne takes far longer to tune.
findings.note: Question style: option rhythm is uniformly long. All 20 options run 14-20 words (median 17) against an authentic ELF median of 10; none is under the corpus p90 of 14. host-2021-verb2-ELF-040's set spans 7-14 words and varies ('The human world versus the world above.' next to a 14-word option). Nothing here exceeds the authentic ELF maximum of 29 words, so this is rhythm, not range.

comparative_note: The restored passage sits comfortably inside the Pantheon exemplar's register: a bylined magazine feature ('Callum Illingsby') dense with unforced particulars (240 kg cast for Larrowden, a 12 kg turning allowance against 228 kg finished, four cents, the 2019 Ockthorne trial where six of the first seven places went to Vennerby and the most precisely tuned bell came ninth) built around a trade disagreement the writer explicitly declines to settle - the same stance as host-2021-verb2-ELF-040's 'much debate over the Pantheon's symbolism' and its 'Even if... do seem to suggest' close. Concrete residue a test-writer would not invent is present throughout, ending on the bin of turnings standing about a third full; there is no reader address, no one-claim-per-paragraph tidiness, and the digression about the experiment that costs two bells is exactly the kind of unresolved aside authentic prose carries. Prompts match the ELF family closely - 'What is implied about...', 'What is the writer's attitude towards...', 'What is this text mainly about?' against the exemplars' 'What is implied in the first two paragraphs?' and 'What is the main point in this text?' - and no option lifts a passage string (longest verbatim run 2 words, against an authentic ELF p99 of 3). Only the uniformly long option rhythm separates it from the exemplars, and it stays inside the authentic band.

findings.quote: Att de båda hantverken byggde på samma kunnande, så att den som behärskade det ena snabbt lärde sig det andra.
findings.note: Question style: three of sixteen options (q1C 19w, q2B 19w, q4A 20w) sit above the authentic LÄS p99 of 18 words, where var-2015-verb2-LÄS-016 and host-2020-verb2-LÄS-020 run 6-12. None exceeds the authentic maximum of 21 words and none uses compound punctuation, so this is at the edge of the range rather than outside it.

comparative_note: Reads as Swedish popular-history prose of the kind LÄS draws on, and is if anything less schematic than var-2019-verb1-LÄS-018, whose exemplar text announces 'problemet är synligt pa tva omraden' and then marches through 'For det forsta' / 'For det andra'. The candidate carries a real, unresolved scholarly dispute - Bostrand's transport-boundary reading, Nyfeldt's ownership-boundary objection, his partial concession in Sladbo and Brantemala, the Strakasen crown-forest counter-case, and her rejoinder that Strakasen is a single area - which is the same 'author declines to close the argument' temperature as host-2020-verb2-LÄS-020. Concrete residue is dense and often argues for nothing at all: the kolardotter who could hear a failing mila before she was ten, the sockenstamma complaints of the 1840s, and above all the Brantemala collier debited in 1868 for fourteen stig that never seem to have been loaded, a debt standing unchanged for twelve years and explicitly unexplained. Options are in paraphrase register throughout (longest verbatim run 4 words, at the authentic LÄS p99); only their length sits at the edge.

findings.quote: Den som inte betalat tillbaka vid Mikaeli fick stå över utlåningen följande vår.
findings.note: Question style: this is a passage string, not a paraphrase. The text reads 'Den som inte hade betalat tillbaka till Mikaeli, i slutet av september, fick stå över utlåningen följande vår.' - the option is that sentence with the appositive gloss deleted and 'till' swapped for 'vid', carrying a 6-word verbatim run ('fick stå över utlåningen följande vår'). Across all 4320 authentic LÄS+ELF options only 10 options of 10+ words carry a verbatim run of 5 or more, and every one of those is a proper noun, a citation or a fixed phrase ('enligt artikel 6.1 i Europakonventionen', 'Joan Sutherland and Montserrat Caballe', 'pa ett sadant satt att') - never a substantive finite predicate that carries the answer. The exemplars paraphrase instead: host-2020-verb2-LÄS-017 renders 'har overtagit forskningens roll som utbildningspolitisk riktningsgivare' as 'De styr utbildningspolitiken.' Prior finding re-judged fresh against the corpus and confirmed; it is not repaired in this round.

findings.quote: För att framhålla att bokens tyngd ligger i fältarbetet snarare än i arkivläsningen: Grimlund har följt varje byggnad ända fram till i dag.
findings.note: Question style: the redesigned q:4 option block is out of range. Its four options run 22/20/21/23 words, where the authentic LÄS maximum across 2160 options is 21; q4A and q4D exceed the entire corpus. The shape is also alien: three of the four pack two propositions behind a colon, semicolon or em-dash, and authentic LÄS options contain zero semicolons in 2160 samples. The eleven authentic options at 20+ words are single clauses long only through forced parallelism (host-2020-verb1-LÄS-020's 'ju mer X..., desto mer Y...' set); none appends a second independent claim. Against var-2019-verb1-LÄS-018, whose options run 6-9 words, this reads as an option written to carry a rationale rather than to be chosen.

findings.quote: För att ge läsaren en paus från bokens paragrafer och förteckningar; de är trevliga men utan betydelse för hennes omdöme om boken.
findings.note: Same dimension as the finding above, recorded so adjudication sees the semicolon shape specifically: 22 words joining an intent clause to an independent evaluative clause by semicolon, a punctuation move with no precedent in the authentic LÄS option corpus.

comparative_note: The passage itself is exemplar-grade and the book-review genre is attested in authentic LÄS (var-2023-verb2-LÄS-018 likewise asks what 'recensenten' faults in a monograph): a signed review with real critical work in it, faulting Grimlund's sparbank thesis out of his own appendix and then fairly conceding that three parishes fit it, with unargued residue like the Sävlinge door hanging in a hembygdsförening exhibit. Its intellectual temperature matches host-2020-verb2-LÄS-020. The flag is entirely at the question layer, and it lands on both the unrepaired and the repaired element: q:2's option A is a near-verbatim lift of the magasinsordning sentence, a move the authentic corpus reserves for proper nouns and citations, and the redesigned q:4 replaces it with four options of 20-23 words that break the authentic ceiling of 21 and use semicolon/colon compounding that never occurs in 2160 authentic LÄS options. Nothing here would make an examinee doubt the text is real HP prose, but both question sets sit outside the exemplar range and adjudication should decide them together.
